title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
summary: In Regency England, sharp-tongued Elizabeth Bennet, one of five sisters whose family estate is entailed away, forms a snap judgement of the proud, wealthy Mr Darcy, and he must change his own as well.
readIf: you love dry humour, sparkling dialogue and a romance built on mutual misjudgement.
skipIf: you want modern settings or can't take a lot of drawing-room conversation.

pairings.reason: Austen's quieter, more mature romance about second chances and regret.
A modern office romance built on the same sparring and slow thaw.
A funny modern reworking of the same story, with plenty of mishaps.
